header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Farhan Ahmed Bozdar advocate for the petitioners.
Mr. Muhammad Sharif Solangi, A.A.G a/w Mr. Anwar Ali
body: Mukhtiarkar (Revenue) Taluka Islamkot and SIP Hamid Ali SHO P.S Islamkot.

Learned A.A.G has filed parawise comments of respondents No.4 and 7, which are taken on record. The grievance of the petitioners is only that they are not allowing to graze their animal. In view of such a position instant petition is disposed of while directing the Deputy Commissioner Tharparkar @ Mithi to call the parties and redress their grievance in accordance with law. JUDGE JUDGE “Saleem”
